fields.statement: QA claude-code-215c18e1 at 8e55f6d4a, by hand with the built binary (go build -o scratchpad/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza) in a scratch Rhiza root and repo with a stub plan-milestone workflow. rhiza run start --foreground --workflow plan --new X --milestone --json reserved 1, 2, 3 (Ship v5, which failed) and then 4, so the failed run's number was skipped. After landing milestone-12 and milestone-50 with --record, the next starts drew 51, 52, 53 and 54. Four run starts launched at once in the background drew 55, 56, 57 and 58, all different. rhiza run status <id> --json shows milestone_number for each. A plan run on an intention (--new with no --milestone) has no milestone_number. Scoped tests pass: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(plan-milestone-number|plan-run-milestone-env|plan-milestone-check|describe-golden)$', ./internal/run, and ./internal/api -run Milestone.

QA claude-code-215c18e1 at 8e55f6d4a, with the built binary, a fake rex that runs the agent command and a fake claude that writes its RHIZA_MILESTONE* environment to a file. A plan-milestone run whose agent interview step reserved 61 launched the planner with RHIZA_MILESTONE_NUMBER=61. A plan run on an intention launched its planner with no RHIZA_MILESTONE_NUMBER. rhiza guide plan (built binary) prints the Milestone bullet: name the intent from RHIZA_MILESTONE_NUMBER (N), handle milestone-N, field milestone=N, done points prefixed mN-, never counting milestones from your own branch. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide ./internal/session and ./internal/api -run Milestone pass.

QA claude-code-215c18e1 at 8e55f6d4a, with the built binary in a scratch root. The stub plan-milestone workflow's first command step writes a milestone intent and a done point into RHIZA_CHANGE, and its next step runs rhiza run milestone-check, as the built-in workflow does. With reserved number 59, a plan writing milestone-59, field milestone=59 and done point m59-first succeeded. With reserved number 60, a plan writing milestone-51, field milestone=51 and done point m51-first (the old count-your-branch clash) failed at the check. Its error says the plan does not use the milestone number 60 the run reserved, and lists three problems: the wrong handle (expected milestone-60), the wrong milestone field and the done point lacking the m60- prefix. It ends with Fix: name the new milestone intent milestone-60 with field milestone=60 and prefix its done points' handles m60- (RHIZA_MILESTONE_NUMBER is 60). The plan-milestone-check script and the ./internal/api Milestone tests pass.
